completenessNote: 来源为 AGC 官方 PDF《S-1_2026-E.pdf》（2 页），本次切分 3 条。该 PDF 为扫描件 + OCR 文本层，正文按版式位置重建：已剔除页眉页脚与边栏条标题、回接折行；未改写措辞、未增删内容。OCR 层面可能存在个别粘连或形近字，逐字引用请以原始 PDF 为准。

text.en: This Order may be cited as the Authority for Info-communications Industry of Brunei Darussalam (Amendment) Order, 2026.

The Authority for Info-communications Technology Industry of Brunei Order, 2001 is amended by deleting "Info-communications" wherever the word appears and by substituting "Infocommunications" therefor. and transitional provisions

(1) Any right, benefit, privilege, obligation or liability acquired, accrued or or any act or thing done or required to be done, shall not be affected by this Order and shall continue to remain valid and have effect as if this Order had not been enacted.

(2) This Order shall not affect any inquiry, investigation or proceedings or pending before the commencement of this Order and every such investigation or proceedings may be continued and dealt with as if this had not been enacted.

(3) In so far as it is necessary for preserving the effect of any written law or any reference in such written law or document to the Authority for Info-communications Technology Industry of Brunei Darussalam shall, as from the commencement of this Order, be construed as a reference to the Authority for Infocommunications Technology Industry of Brunei Darussalam. Made this 20th. day of Rejab, 1447 Hijriah corresponding to the lOth. day of January, 2026 at Our Istana Nurul !man, Bandar Seri Begawan, Darussalam.

HIS MAJESTY

THE SULTAN AND YANG DI-PERTUAN, DARUSSALAM. oleh Print Plus Sdn. Bhd., Bandar Seri Begawan BB3510, Negara Brunei Darussalam.
